content.text: How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

So how does it work? Simply put, Cloudflare R2 uses a combination of cloudflare workers and Google Apps Script to automate digital product delivery. When a customer purchases a product, the transaction is verified on-chain via NOWPayments, and the product is then automatically delivered to the customer's email via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This means that you can focus on creating and selling your digital products while your infrastructure handles the heavy lifting. Plus, with Cloudflare R2, you can store and deliver an unlimited number of digital products without incurring any additional storage fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Cloudflare R2 is designed specifically for digital creators who want to take control of their digital commerce infrastructure without breaking the bank. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or any other type of digital product, Cloudflare R2 provides a scalable and reliable solution that can grow with your business. And with our Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack in no time. From there, you can focus on what matters most – creating and selling your digital products to a global audience.
The Components That Make It Work Together

So what are the key components that make Cloudflare R2 work together seamlessly? First, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments into your digital commerce stack to verify transactions on-chain. Next, you'll need to configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate digital product delivery. Finally, you'll need to set up Cloudflare R2 to store and deliver your digital products. With these components in place, you can focus on creating and selling your digital products while your infrastructure handles the rest.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Now that you know the ins and outs of Cloudflare R2, it's time to get started. First, head over to our Shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Next, integrate NOWPayments into your digital commerce stack and configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate digital product delivery. Finally, set up Cloudflare R2 to store and deliver your digital products. With these steps in place, you'll be well on your way to taking control of your digital commerce infrastructure and selling your digital products to a global audience without relying on Stripe or any other payment gateway.
The Benefits of Using Cloudflare R2 for Digital Product Storage and Delivery

So what are the benefits of using Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery? First and foremost, you'll save $921 at 100 sales per month compared to using Gumroad. Plus, you'll own and control every aspect of your digital commerce stack, from product delivery to customer interactions. This means that you can focus on creating and selling your digital products while your infrastructure handles the heavy lifting. With Cloudflare R2, you can store and deliver an unlimited number of digital products without incurring any additional storage fees. And with our Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack in no time.
What is Cloudflare R2 storage?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
